lines.text: I’ve fallen hard before, I’ve hit the ground and stayed
Built walls so high I almost threw the key away
But you don’t ask me to be fearless, you just open up your hands
And suddenly the landing doesn’t feel so far from where I stand
I don’t have to be unbreakable to be held
I don’t have to earn the safety that you give so well
Soft landing, that’s what you are to me
After every storm, you’re the place I get to be
No more crashing, no more breaking on my own
Soft landing — finally home
You don’t fix the pieces, you just let them rearrange
You let me cry the ugly tears and never look away
I used to think that love meant always being strong
Now I know it’s letting someone catch you when you’re wrong
I don’t have to be unbreakable to be held
I don’t have to earn the safety that you give so well
Soft landing, that’s what you are to me
After every storm, you’re the place I get to be
No more crashing, no more breaking on my own
Soft landing — finally home
I’m still learning how to trust the fall
But with you I don’t have to land alone at all
Soft landing, that’s what you are to me
After every storm, you’re the place I get to be
No more crashing, no more breaking on my own
Soft landing — finally home
